resume: Orbiting overtone synth: four corners of two generators each, a sun on a path and a moon around it decide how much of each corner you hear. The knobs shape the selected planet. Made for the SMK-37; here its FM-1 build.

commandes.role: Opens the FX knob set; a new press closes it.
Next knob page (K1 to K4, then K5 to K8).
Opens the matching knob set (CHORD); a new press closes it.
Opens the matching knob set (FADER BANK); a new press closes it.
Held, the 16 lowest keys replace the pads (four groups of four); EDIT + PLAY restarts, EDIT + SEQ cuts all notes.
Opens the ARP knob set; a new press closes it.
Starts; its BPM is also set on the ARP set, or with PLAY.
27 keys (F3 to G5), fixed velocity at 100; their LEDs show the held notes.

a_savoir: The FM-1 version is experimental: built and checked on a computer, never played on a real FM-1.
The FM-1 has no pads, faders or wheels: the path (FAMILY, SIZE, SPEED, MORPH) is on page 3, KNOB 1 to 4.
Vector37 keeps no data of its own on the FM-1: no saving of sounds or settings.
